articles.headline: India prepares rollout of agentic payments on UPI
articles.whyItMatters: AI-driven autonomous payments will redefine digital finance and merchant ecosystems.
articles.brief: Sources indicate India is gearing up to introduce agentic payments via UPI, marking a major leap in automated digital financial transactions.

articles.headline: India GDP grows better-than-expected at 7.8%
articles.whyItMatters: Robust quarterly growth defies global economic headwinds and signals strong domestic investment.
articles.brief: India's economy expanded by a stronger-than-expected 7.8% in the April-June quarter, driven largely by a sharp surge in domestic investments.

articles.headline: Nepal flood death toll crosses 1,050
articles.whyItMatters: Catastrophic monsoon devastation requires massive regional humanitarian and rescue responses.
articles.brief: The death toll from devastating floods in Nepal has surpassed 1,050 as rescue teams finally reach isolated remote areas with DNA analysis and drones.

articles.headline: India explores opacified polymer substrate for currency
articles.whyItMatters: Shifting to plastic notes enhances security against counterfeiting and improves durability.
articles.brief: The RBI's currency-printing subsidiary has invited global bids to supply opacified polymer substrate sheets, signaling plans for polymer banknotes.

articles.headline: US Treasury warns Strait of Hormuz could face disruption
articles.whyItMatters: Geopolitical chokepoints directly impact global oil supply chains and energy security.
articles.brief: Amid escalating US-Iran tensions and military strikes, US Treasury Secretary Bessent warned about the future stability of critical energy shipping lanes.

articles.headline: SpaceX acquires AI coding startup Cursor for $60B
articles.whyItMatters: Major consolidation in AI tooling highlights massive valuations and strategic tech acquisitions.
articles.brief: Elon Musk's SpaceX has acquired AI coding platform Cursor for $60 billion, sparking new industry competition and highlighting Indian-origin founders.

articles.headline: Maharashtra FDA suspends Blinkit hub over hygiene
articles.whyItMatters: Strict food safety enforcement targets quick-commerce dark stores to protect consumer health.
articles.brief: State authorities suspended food licenses for Blinkit hubs and partner outlets in Mumbai following serious hygiene and safety violations.

articles.headline: India revives talks with Zambia for critical minerals
articles.whyItMatters: Securing foreign critical mineral assets is vital for India's clean energy and manufacturing transition.
articles.brief: India has restarted diplomatic and economic negotiations with Zambia to secure direct access investments in essential critical minerals.

articles.headline: Oracle employees track Slack counts amid layoff fears
articles.whyItMatters: Tech sector workforce reductions continue to impact major enterprise software companies globally.
articles.brief: Following major restructuring charges and heavy AI infrastructure spending, tech employees are anxiously monitoring headcount metrics as layoff rumors circulate.
